hero.label: A Love Story
hero.title: Our Story
hero.subtitle: One bold sister, one late-night message, and everything after.

events.title: A Tap on the Shoulder
events.story:
Jeff was up at the bar with his friend Albert, grabbing another round for the group, when a girl walked over and tapped him on the shoulder. It was Victoria — Paige's older sister — and she got straight to the point: *"You're cute, you should date my sister"*.

They talked for a few minutes. Jeff found out who Paige was, and before they went their separate ways he had her Instagram handle. He messaged Paige the moment he got home that night. They talked until neither of them could keep their eyes open.
events.photo_alt: Harry's Taproom — where Jeff and Paige's story began

events.title: The First Date
events.story:
After weeks of late-night messages, Jeff and Paige headed to Brick & Barrel for their first date. Our conversation flowed effortlessly. What we liked to do, what we did for work, where we wanted our lives to go. After a while it didn't feel like a first date at all.

At some point Jeff got up to use the bathroom, and when he came back Paige mentioned that their waitress had stopped by the table to say how cute they were together. Even strangers could see it. By the end of the night, Jeff already knew — Paige was exactly who he'd been looking for.
events.photo_alt: Brick & Barrel — Jeff and Paige's first date

events.title: Making It Official
events.story:
By February, Jeff was sure he had a girlfriend. There had been date after date, flowers, Valentine's Day gifts — as far as he was concerned, the case was closed. There was just one problem: in Paige’s mind, they weren't dating at all.

One night she sat him down and asked, point-blank, _"What are we?"_ Jeff, who thought he'd answered that question with a bouquet weeks earlier, finally said it out loud. That night we became a couple — officially this time, with both of us in on it.
events.photo_alt: Jeff and Paige dressed up for a night out

events.title: Building Our World
events.story:
Dating Paige meant getting to know the Mullens, and the Mullens are a game family. Card games around the table, always with a new one to learn, and Switch battles that run later than anyone planned. Jeff learned quickly that game night can get competitive, and that this is a family that genuinely loves being together. Somewhere between rounds, he stopped feeling like a guest.

The trips kept coming, too. A week in Mexico and Tennessee with Paige's family, multiple households all in together. Corolla on the Outer Banks every fall with Jeff's family, a tradition that quietly became non-negotiable. And when it was just the two of us, Columbus to see Morgan Wallen, Orlando, Tampa and St. Pete: wandering, eating, drinking, and finding the next good thing.

But most of the best moments happened on ordinary days. Enjoying shows together, cooking a new recipe, finding new hobbies, or trying to find the spot with the best Bavarian pretzel.

The years filled in fast. Life got fuller with each one.
events.photo_alt: Jeff and Paige at the beach

events.title: She Said Yes
events.story:
Paige's cousin Macenzie and her boyfriend Brendan were coming in from Illinois for a visit, and that was reason enough for a night out: the G6 crew — Jeff, Paige, Devin, Kyle, Victoria, and Chris — plus Macenzie and Brendan, all heading to New Hope for drinks and fries at Stella.

As the day got closer, the plan started to unravel (purposefully). One by one, everyone decided they'd just drive up separately. Jeff and Paige set off together, while the rest of the group was supposedly right behind them — "on their way," they said. They never showed.

Jeff had a plan, and it started with a parking spot. Paige drove, Jeff rode passenger princess, and he plugged in the directions so she would follow them without asking questions. Well, if you know Paige, she started asking questions. We eventually found street parking and it somehow ended up with Paige saying “I told you so”.

We got out of the car and started walking on the path along the river, right behind Stella. The walkway opened up, with the water in front of them and the bridge in the background. Jeff got down on one knee. She said yes.

Afterward, we went in for the reservation — just the two of us, savoring the moment before the world knew. Then we drove over to Warwick Brewing, where our friends and family were waiting, and celebrated with the people who had known all along.
events.photo_alt: Paige in a bridal veil, hugging Jeff and showing her engagement ring

events.title: Forever Starts Here
events.story: It started with a stranger at a bar, a bold sister, and a late-night DM. It ends — or really begins — at HollyHedge Estate in New Hope, surrounded by the people who have been part of this story all along. We're so glad you're one of them.
